description: Expected content moderation levels per governance zone (canonical Option A: Zone 1 (Enterprise) = strictest, Zone 3 (Personal) = least restrictive)

Medium.regulatory: GLBA 501(b) — Insufficient content protection for enterprise agent

Low.regulatory: SOX 404 — Inadequate content controls for shared agent

Medium.regulatory: Best practice uplift recommended for team agents

Low.regulatory: Governance gap — Below minimum content moderation threshold

Unknown.description: Unclassified environment — fail-safe defaults to High minimum. Low moderation in an unclassified environment is High severity (governance gap + inadequate moderation). Medium is Warning (zone assignment gap only).

Low.regulatory: Governance gap — Unclassified environment with minimal content moderation

Medium.regulatory: Governance gap — Environment not assigned to zone
